questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 7। Cycle শেষে internal energy change zero। net work=net heat=Qin−Qout=2×(7) J।
questions.subject: Physics

questions.question_bn: Rest থেকে constant acceleration 4 m/s²। 3-তম second-এ distance কত m?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 3। s((3))−s((3)−1)=2×(3)²−2((3)−1)²=4×(3)−2। মোট distance আর nth-second distance আলাদা।
questions.subject: Physics

questions.question_bn: Simple magnifier f=25/3 cm, eye near-point 25 cm। final image at near-point হলে angular magnification কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 3। Near-point magnification M=1+D/f=1+25/(25/(3))=(3)+1; infinity-image case M=D/f।
questions.subject: Physics

questions.question_bn: Gascontainedtotaltranslationalenergy 27 J,volume 2L। idealisotropicgaspressure কত Pa?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 9। Ktrans=(3/2)PV⇒P=2 K/(3 V)=6×(9)/(3·0.002)=1000n Pa; litreSIconversion।
questions.book_reference: আদর্শ গ্যাস ও গতিতত্ত্ব · HSC PCM পাঠ্যক্রম
questions.subject: Physics

questions.question_bn: Circular satellite-এর speed 6 m/s। force-এর instantaneous power কত W?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 6। Gravity radial এবং velocity tangential, তাই F·v=0। force কাজ না করেও velocity direction বদলায়।
questions.book_reference: মহাকর্ষ ও অভিকর্ষ · HSC PCM পাঠ্যক্রম
questions.subject: Physics

questions.question_bn: Common-emitter switch: emitter grounded, VCC=12 V, RC=1kΩ, β=50, IB=130μA। saturation-এ VCE=0.2 V। active/saturation দুটো অবস্থা বিবেচনা করে collector current কত mA?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 13। Active prediction Ic=βIb=0.5×(13) mA। Load সীমা Ic=(12−0.2)/1000=11.8mA। prediction এই সীমা ছাড়ালে transistor saturated; ছোট মানটি নিতে হবে।
questions.book_reference: সেমিকন্ডাক্টর ও ইলেকট্রনিক্স · HSC PCM পাঠ্যক্রম
questions.subject: Physics

questions.question_bn: Speed v=L/t। L=(5±0.01)m,t=(2±0.02)s। first-ordermaxfractionaluncertainty কোনটি?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 5। Fractionaluncertaintyquotient-এ magnitudesadd:δv/v≤δL/L+δt/t=0.01/(5)+0.02/2। sameunitfractions দরকার।
questions.book_reference: ভৌতজগৎ ও পরিমাপ · HSC PCM পাঠ্যক্রম
questions.subject: Physics

questions.question_bn: Circular coil radius RcentreB₀। same coil on axis distance√3R,B/B₀ কত? current 4A
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 4। OnaxisB/B₀=R³/(R²+x²)^(3/2)=(1+3)^(-3/2)=1/8। current cancels ratio।
questions.chapter_title: তড়িৎ প্রবাহের চৌম্বক ক্রিয়া ও চুম্বকত্ব

questions.subject: Physics

questions.question_bn: Particle velocity first(15,20),then(15,−20)m/s,transition 2s; average acceleration magnitude কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 5। Δv=(0,−8×(5)), elapsed 2s⇒aavg=(0,−4×(5)),magnitude 4×(5)। speed unchanged কিন্তু vector velocity বদলেছে।
questions.subject: Physics

questions.question_bn: |a|=|b|=5, a ও b সমান্তরাল নয়। (a+b)·(a−b) কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 5। Dot distributivity-এ cross terms cancel: (a+b)·(a−b)=|a|²−|b|²=0।
questions.subject: Physics

questions.question_bn: 6Ω ও 6Ω series across 12 V। দ্বিতীয় resistor-এর parallel-এ আরও 6Ω load দিলে load voltage কত V?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 6। Loaded second branch Req=(6)/2; total 3×(6)/2। divider voltage 12·((6)/2)/(3×(6)/2)=4 V।
questions.subject: Physics

questions.question_bn: F(x)=2x N, mass 11 kg rest থেকে x=0→3 m। final speed² কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 11। Work ∫₀³2x dx=9 J。 work-energy ½mv²=9⇒v²=18/(11)।
questions.book_reference: কাজ, শক্তি ও ক্ষমতা · HSC PCM পাঠ্যক্রম
questions.subject: Physics

questions.question_bn: 10 mol ideal diatomic gas, vibrational modes frozen। U/(RT) কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 10। Diatomic rigid molecule-এর degrees f=5। internal energy U=(f/2)nRT=(5×(10)/2)RT।
questions.book_reference: আদর্শ গ্যাস ও গতিতত্ত্ব · HSC PCM পাঠ্যক্রম
questions.subject: Physics

questions.question_bn: Two coherent sources individual intensities I ও 4I, I=6। Imax/Imin কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 6। Amplitudes proportional√I: A,2A। max intensity 9I, minI। ratio 9; intensities সরাসরি add নয়।
questions.subject: Physics

questions.question_bn: Gas mixture 7 mol N₂,2 mol O₂; total pressure 3atm। O₂ partial pressure কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 7। Dalton partial Poxygen=xo₂Ptotal=[2/((7)+2)]·3=6/((7)+2)atm। mole fraction relevant, mass fraction নয়।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Food oil iodometry-তে I₂ 22mmol মুক্ত। I₂+2S₂O₃²⁻→2I⁻+S₄O₆²⁻। thiosulfate কত mmol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 22। Reaction coefficients iodine 1 ও thiosulfate 2। তাই nmmol iodine fully titrate করতে 2nmmol thiosulfate।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Acyclic mono alkyne C15H28। total sigma-bond count কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 15। Carbon skeleton (15)−1sigma ও hydrogen 2×(15)−2sigma। total 3×(15)−3; triple bond contains oneσ andtwoπ।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Diluted water initial DO8mg/L, after 5days 6mg/L; sample fraction 1/18, blank correction 0। BOD₅ কত mg/L?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 18। DO depletion=2mg/L in diluted mixture। Original sample BOD=(DOinitial−DOfinal)/fraction=2nmg/L।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Ore270g contains 80%Fe₂O₃। complete Feproduction, MFe₂O₃160,MFe56। iron mass কত g?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 27। Pure oxide 8ng; Femassfraction 112/160=0.7。 actual iron 8×(27)·0.7=5.6ng; impurityremovedfirst।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Water Ca²⁺ 22mmol। soap RCOO⁻ stoichiometric precipitate Ca(RCOO)₂ হলে soap anion কত mmol consumed?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 22। Charge-balanced salt requires 2monovalent carboxylate per Ca²⁺। nmmol Ca consumes 2×(22) mmolsoap।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: 19 mol monohydric alcohol excess Na-এর সঙ্গে react। H₂ produced কত mol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 19। 2ROH+2Na→2RONa+H₂। alcohol:H₂=2:1; H atom pair করে gas, তাই (19)/2 mol।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Molten NaCl electrolysis,total charge 14F। Cl₂moles কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 14। Anode 2Cl⁻→Cl₂+2e⁻। equalcircuitchargegivesn/2 mol Cl₂; aqueouscompetingreactionsexcludedby moltencondition।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: At fixedT Henry c=kP, dissolved gas concentration c₀ atP₀। P=17P₀ হলে concentration কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 17। Stated Henry form c=kP linear। sameT,k-এ pressure factor (17) gives concentration factor (17); alternative H conventions আলাদা হতে পারে।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: HaberprocessN₂input 27 mol,H₂excess,singlepassN₂conversion 25%। NH₃out কত mol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 27। ReactedN₂=(27)/4 mol。 N₂→2NH₃mole factor 2⇒NH₃(27)/2 mol; unreactedN₂recyclingwouldadditionalpasses।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Wet food 45 kg moisture 40%w/w। সব water remove, dry solid unchanged। dry mass কত kg?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 9। Dry fraction 1−0.4=0.6। conserved nonvolatile dry solid=5×(9)·0.6=3×(9) kg; water removed 2×(9)।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: N₂+3H₂→2NH₃। initial N₂=19 mol,H₂=38 mol। maximumNH₃ কত mol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 19। H₂limiting:reactionextent=(2×(19))/3,availableN₂(19) larger। NH₃=2extent=4×(19)/3 mol; balanced coefficients essential।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: এক fat molecule-এ 25 C=C bond।1 mol fat fully hydrogenate করতে H₂ কত mol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 25। Each C=C accepts 1H₂ on catalytic hydrogen at ion। প্রতি molecule ndoublebond→1 mol fat-এর জন্য (25) molH₂।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Sample mass 7g,80%CaCO₃。 excessacidCO₂amount কত mol? MCaCO₃=100
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 7। Pure CaCO₃mass 0.8ng⇒moles 0.8×(7)/100=(7)/125。 carbonateCO₂1:1; impurity inert stated।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: CaCO₃calcination 1tonnepurefeed; carbonateconversion 26%। emittedCO₂kg কত? MCaCO₃100,MCO₂44
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 26। Convertedmass 1000·(26)/100=10nkg CaCO₃। CO₂mass fraction 44/100⇒4.4nkg; combustionemissionexcluded।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Arrhenius equation-এ Ea/R=4000 K। T₁=300 K,T₂=600 K। ln(k₂/k₁) কত?
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: 0.1M HCl 42 mL ও 0.1M NaOH 21 mL mix; additive volume। final[H⁺] কত M?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 21। Initial H⁺0.2×(21) mmol, OH⁻0.1×(21) mmol; excess 0.1×(21) mmol,total 3×(21) mL। concentration 0.1/3=1/30M।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Ureasample 1440g। nitrogen mass কত g? CO(NH₂)₂,MW60
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 24। Eachureamolecule 2nitrogen atoms⇒28g Nper 60gurea। sample 60nghas 28ngN; mass fraction not atom fraction।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: H-like ion Z=22, transition 3→2। photon energy/13.6eV কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 22। Energy difference Z²(1/2²−1/3²)=Z²(1/4−1/9)=5Z²/36। emission energy positive।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Cu²⁺+2e⁻→Cu। charge 23F passes,current efficiency 100%,MCu64। depositedmass কত g?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 23। nF=(23) mole electrons। cumoles=(23)/2, mass=((23)/2)·64=32ng; valency 2denominator।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Gas collected over water total pressure 31k Pa, water vapour 2k Pa। dry gas partial pressure কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 11। Dalton total P=Pdry+Pwater। dry pressure=Ptotal−Pvapour=(11)+18k Pa; vapour pressure বাদ দিতে হয়।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Impure CaCO₃sample excessHCl 24mmol reacts। leftoveracid needs NaOH 6mmol। CaCO₃ amount কত mmol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 6। HClconsumed=4×(6)−(6)=3nmmol। CaCO₃+2HCl uses 2acidpercarbonate; CaCO₃=1.5nmmol।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Weak monoprotic HA concentration 0.10M, Ka=144×10⁻⁸। x≪C। [H⁺] approx কত M?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 12। Ka≈x²/C⇒x=√(KaC)=√((12)²×10⁻⁹)=(12)×10⁻⁴⋅⁵। stated approximation check x/C ছোট থাকতে হবে।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: AcidicKMnO₄ 3mmol fullyoxidises Fe²⁺→Fe³⁺। Fe²⁺amount কত mmol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 3। MnO₄⁻acidic Mn²⁺-এ 5electronaccepts। each Fe²⁺oneelectronloses⇒5Fe²⁺perpermanganate।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Acid ও alcohol 1:1 ester if i cation, limiting acid 15 mol, isolated yield 75%। ester mole কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 15। Theoretical ester amount limiting acid (15) mol। actual 75%=0.75×(15)=3×(15)/4; excess alcohol yield multiplier নয়।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: M²⁺+2e⁻→M(s),25°C। ion concentration 10⁻11M। E−E° কত V?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 11। Q=1/[M²⁺]=10ⁿ, solidsactivity 1। Nernstshift−0.0592×(11)/2=−0.0296nV; dilution reduction potential কমায়।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Acyclic hydrocarbon C18H36 with oneC=C, no ring। sigma-bond count কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 18। C–C skeleton tree has (18)−1sigma, including double-bond oneσ। C–H bonds 2×(18)σ। total 3×(18)−1; πbond excluded।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: A⇌B, initial[A]=7M,[B]=0। equilibrium[B]=1M। Kc কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 7। Stoichiometry 1:1-এ A decreases 1M। equilibrium[A]=(7)−1; Kc=[B]/[A]=1/((7)−1), initial concentration নয়।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Equal volumes AgNO₃ ও Na Cl, each 22×10⁻⁴M। Ag Cl Ksp1×10⁻⁸। initial ionic product কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 22। Mixing doubles total volume, each ion concentration (22)×10⁻⁴/2। Qsp=((22)²/4)×10⁻⁸; তারপর Ksp তুলনা করে precipitation।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Two equal bond dipoles μ=23D make 120°। net dipole কত D?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 23। Vector resultant 2μcos60°=μ=nD। linear 180°-এ zero; dipoles scalar যোগ নয়।
questions.book_reference: পর্যায়বৃত্ত ধর্ম ও রাসায়নিক বন্ধন · HSC PCM পাঠ্যক্রম
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Ag Cl Ksp=1×10⁻¹⁰। Na Cl solution [Cl⁻]=8×10⁻²M, Ag Cl saturated; s≪[Cl⁻]। [Ag⁺] কত M?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 8। Ksp=[Ag⁺][Cl⁻]। common-ion approximation s=10⁻¹⁰/((8)×10⁻²)=(1/(8))×10⁻⁸M।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Electron momentum 22p₀। wavelength ratio λ/λ₀ কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 22। de Broglie λ=h/p। momentum factor (22)⇒wavelength factor 1/(22); kinetic energy ratio হলে square-root লাগত।
questions.subject: Chemistry
